comment: The effect budget: the load that the Deck test held at 60 frames per second on 2026-09-17 (D-523, D-617). Each row is a floor, and not the limit of the Deck (F-66). A change of a row cites a Deck measurement before and after it (G-14). The light row counts the lights whose range reaches the worst view of 640 by 360 art pixels, the carried light included (D-842, D-847). PR-57 to PR-60 and PR-92 add their rows.
